summary: Webpack loader fetches and executes remote shell payload from hardcoded IP
details: dist/bsrc-loader.js, invoked via the webpack loader chain when the widget's renderer.umd is required, probes the internal endpoint http://bsrc-ssrf.n.baidu-int.com/bsrc_uid and, on Linux when the consuming project name matches 'npm-widget-build', spawns /bin/sh -c to execute a shell payload retrieved over plain HTTP from http://49.232.169.67:80/slt (curl||wget piped to sh). The loader additionally POSTs the SSRF probe result together with process context (pid, cwd base64-encoded, stage marker) to http://49.232.169.67:43817/bsrc-r266. The remote shell script is fetched unauthenticated over cleartext from a bare IP and executed on the build host, and internal-network probe output plus process metadata are relayed off-host to the same attacker-controlled endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
